scope: Source-only automatic continuous141-frame trim selection. A sampling rule for new Native screening, not an intervention window or new method claim.

full_preparation.scale: aspect-ratio fit, dimensions divisible by2, centered black padding; same as R24
full_preparation.mapping: actual ffmpeg showinfo checksums before/after fps, plus original and prepared timestamps

valid_joint: finite,score>=threshold,inframe; original selector unchanged; ambiguous selected frame invalid for selection
smoothing: normalized mean unit direction over3 consecutive valid frames; no gap fill

turn.definition: opposite signs of signed angular changes from t-4 to t and t to t+4; each magnitude>=15deg
turn.strength: sum weights times min(leftangle,rightangle,90deg) over reversing bones
turn.note: Geometric pose reversal proxy; does not identify semantic action categories.

visibility_tiers.2: anchor>=.8, each arm chain>=.8, each leg chain>=.6, ambiguity<=.05
visibility_tiers.1: anchor>=.8, each arm chain>=.8, ambiguity<=.05 but not fullbody tier2
visibility_tiers.0: no adequate arm/torso support; keep selected clip with UNKNOWN eligibility

ranking: max tier, then count of nonmax-selected reversal events, then mean of anchor/leftarm/rightarm/leftleg/rightleg coverages, then sum event strength, then earliest start; tier0 instead max mean support, then eventcount/strength, then earliest
outputs: All starts, coverages at.3/.5, event candidates and chosen centers, reject reasons, ranking tuple, selected frame map, full raw pose. All3sources retained even UNKNOWN.
selection_limits: No generated output read or used.
Pose confidence is raw score, not calibrated probability.
View changes/occlusion/track errors can affect apparent reversal count.
Selection prioritizes visibility and direction changes, not evidence that generation will fail.
selected_clip_encoding: Trim the full prepared timeline exactly; H264 libx264 qp0 lossless YUV, verify every decodedYUV frame equals the selected full-frame slice. Reuse corresponding full-pose JSON frames with explicit offset after exactYUV verification.
